meta.description: LichSpec star catalogue: every Hipparcos star with V < 7.0 and every named fainter one, with Gaia DR3 astrophysical parameters; plus famous stars outside Hipparcos from Gaia DR3 (extra)
sources: ESA 1997, The Hipparcos Catalogue (via Gaia archive public.hipparcos)
van Leeuwen 2007, Hipparcos new reduction (via ARI Heidelberg Gaia TAP): position and parallax of named stars the 1997 query did not return (no spectral type for these)
Gaia Collaboration 2023, Gaia DR3 gaia_source and astrophysical_parameters
d3-celestial 0.7.35 (BSD-3, O. Frohn): starnames.json (names, Turkish names), stars.14.json (V and B-V of the supplementary rows), constellations.bounds.json
meta.epoch: stars: ICRS, epoch 1991.25 (named stars in neither Hipparcos reduction, without a parallax: J2000 from d3-celestial); extra: Gaia DR3, epoch 2016.0
